name: Job
summary: Job was a man in the land of Uz who was perfect and upright, feared God and turned away from evil. He lost his children, his wealth and his health but did not sin in what he said, and in the end the LORD gave him double what he had before.

key_moments.title: Satan's Challenge
key_moments.description: The LORD said there was none like His servant Job on the earth. Satan answered that Job feared God only because God had blessed him, so the LORD let Satan touch all that Job had, but not Job himself.

key_moments.title: Everything Lost in a Day
key_moments.description: Messenger after messenger told Job that his animals and servants were taken or killed, and that a great wind had struck the house where his children were, killing them. Job tore his robe, fell down and worshipped, and blessed the LORD's name.

key_moments.title: Covered in Boils
key_moments.description: Satan covered Job with painful boils from head to foot, and he sat among the ashes. His wife urged him to curse God so he would die, but Job asked whether they should accept good from God and not trouble.

key_moments.title: The LORD Speaks from the Storm
key_moments.description: The LORD spoke to Job from the whirlwind. He asked Job where he was when He set the earth's foundations, as the stars of morning sang.

key_moments.title: Blessed Twice Over
key_moments.description: When Job prayed for his three friends, the LORD restored him and gave him double what he had before. Again he had seven sons and three daughters, and he lived 140 more years.
